# DevQueens

> DevQueens is one studio that ships three things: process automation, AI agents on your product, and AI marketing. Automations that drain the manual queue. AI agents that close customers inside your product. AI marketing that puts your business inside ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity, right where buyers now search. Fixed scope, fixed timeline, fixed price. Measured in revenue.

## Three lines of work

### Line 1: Process Automation ($5K to $20K)

Four to six weeks. We take one painful workflow and ship it live. Three way invoice matching with supporting evidence attached. Exception routing. Reconciliation and approval queues. Example volume handled: 800 invoices a month, 90,000 cases a month. Your team watches the queue drain before signing off on production.

### Line 2: AI Agent Surface ($10K to $25K)

Three to five weeks. The full agent surface against your API: availability, booking, cancellation, payment, refund. Delivered into OpenAI Operator, Claude computer use, ChatGPT, and WhatsApp Business. Meta WhatsApp Business platform review included. Braintrust or Langfuse evals, cost caps, and a runbook your team can operate.

### Line 3: AI Marketing ($1,500 setup + $300 monthly)

Marketing for the layer that comes after Google. We audit and restructure your hours, prices, catalog, availability, and profiles so ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and the WhatsApp agents your customers already use read your business correctly. Optional monthly monitoring flags the day they stop.

### Ops Retainer ($1,500 to $3,000 per month)

Covers OAuth token rotation, API schema drift, model release regressions that break tuned prompts, platform policy changes, eval maintenance, and security reviews. No emergency statements of work, no scope creep bills.

## Entry point for every engagement

Every engagement starts with a $3,000 to $7,000 paid proof of concept in 5 to 10 days. One real action against your real data. An invoice reconciled against a purchase order. A booking placed through your API. A lead captured from an agent conversation. Priced to filter, not to delight procurement. Never free.

## Receipts

- **Three way matching, automated**: compared invoices against purchase orders and delivery receipts, flagged price and quantity discrepancies, routed exceptions to approvers with supporting evidence attached. 800 invoices a month.
- **Booking connector in 5 weeks**: production connector between a scheduling SaaS and OpenAI Operator, plus a WhatsApp Business agent. 40,000 bookings a month flow through the agent surface. Zero manual overrides.
- **Investor demo rescue**: called in Tuesday, by Friday had rewritten a broken agent loop, patched a retrieval bug, added evals and cost caps. Held the live demo through 30 minutes of investor questions with zero hallucinations.

## Pricing philosophy

Public prices, fixed scope, fixed timeline. We anchor to what you capture, not what we clock. An automation that clears 800 invoices a month returns 40 approver hours a week. An AI agent that captures 50 bookings a week unlocks real revenue. A profile audit that makes your business legible to ChatGPT turns searches into clients.

## Who we work with

- Product and operations teams at companies with manual queues that bleed hours.
- Vertical SaaS platforms whose customers want to transact through consumer AI agents.
- Small and local businesses that want to be found and correctly represented inside the AI tools where buyers now search.

Every build is tailored to the company. One studio delivers all three lines, so the automation, the agent, and the marketing speak the same language and share the same data model.
